session.zh: 跨市场收盘 · 美国 / 香港 9 月 14 日
session.en: Cross-market close · US / Hong Kong Sep 14

headline.zh: 油价、长端利率与 AI 风险偏好共同施压美股；恒指逆势小幅收高，DRAM 现货仍呈局部变动。
headline.en: Oil, long yields and AI risk appetite pressured US equities; the Hang Seng edged higher while DRAM spot pricing remained selective.

summary.zh: 截至上海时间 9 月 15 日早晨，9 月 14 日是美港最近完整交易日。标普 500 下跌 0.5% 至 7,619.98，纳指下跌 0.6% 至 26,186.41；恒指上涨 111 点或 0.45% 至 24,917。AP 报道布伦特原油收于每桶 105.68 美元，10 年期美债收益率盘中短暂触及 5.00%、收于 4.98%。AI 股在行业领导者提出放缓开发以留出安全措施时间后承压；这只是市场风险偏好信息，不能直接推断观察名单公司的收入或竞争力。TrendForce 的 9 月 14 日现货报价显示 DDR5 16Gb (2Gx8) 4800/5600 持平于 54.333 美元，DDR4 8Gb (1Gx8) 3200 持平于 45.214 美元，DDR4 16Gb (2Gx8) 3200 下跌 0.56% 至 89.250 美元。
summary.en: As of the morning of September 15 in Shanghai, September 14 was the latest completed US and Hong Kong session. The S&P 500 fell 0.5% to 7,619.98 and the Nasdaq 0.6% to 26,186.41; the Hang Seng gained 111 points, or 0.45%, to 24,917. AP reported Brent settled at $105.68 per barrel, while the 10-year Treasury yield briefly touched 5.00% intraday and ended at 4.98%. AI shares weakened after industry leaders called for slower development to allow safety measures to catch up; this is risk-appetite information, not direct evidence of watchlist-company revenue or competitiveness. TrendForce's September 14 spot quotes showed DDR5 16Gb (2Gx8) 4800/5600 unchanged at $54.333, DDR4 8Gb (1Gx8) 3200 unchanged at $45.214, and DDR4 16Gb (2Gx8) 3200 down 0.56% to $89.250.

label.zh: 油价、利率与 AI 风险偏好交织
label.en: Oil, rates and AI risk appetite intersect

title.zh: 长端利率接近 5% 时，估值敏感资产的波动风险上升。
title.en: With long yields near 5%, valuation-sensitive assets face greater volatility risk.

detail.zh: 美股下跌伴随油价反弹与 AI 相关股走弱，香港市场则小幅收高。将此视作折现率与风险偏好共同施压是分析判断；它不预测联储政策、AI 监管或企业盈利。
detail.en: US equities fell alongside higher oil and weaker AI-linked shares, while Hong Kong edged higher. Reading this as joint pressure from discount rates and risk appetite is analysis; it does not forecast Fed policy, AI regulation or company earnings.

label.zh: 美国 10 年期国债收益率 · Sep 14

title.zh: 油价和长端利率限制美股风险偏好
title.en: Oil and long yields constrain US risk appetite

detail.zh: AP 报道布伦特原油上涨 1% 至 105.68 美元，10 年期美债收益率盘中触及 5.00%、收于 4.98%。标普 500 下跌 37.00 点至 7,619.98；该组合提高估值敏感资产的波动风险，但不单独决定货币政策。
detail.en: AP reported Brent rose 1% to $105.68 and the 10-year Treasury yield briefly touched 5.00% before ending at 4.98%. The S&P 500 fell 37.00 points to 7,619.98; the combination raises volatility risk for valuation-sensitive assets but does not by itself determine monetary policy.

title.zh: AI 相关股承压，但不等同于基本面结论
title.en: AI-linked shares weaken, without proving a fundamental conclusion

detail.zh: AP 报道，AI 行业领导者提出应放缓开发以让安全措施跟上后，AI 相关股票在全球范围走弱；纳指下跌 0.6%，韩国 Kospi 下跌 3.3%。这说明风险偏好变化，而非 AAPL、GOOGL、MSFT、腾讯或泡泡玛特经营业绩的新证据。
detail.en: AP reported that AI-linked shares weakened globally after industry leaders called for slower development to let safety measures catch up; the Nasdaq fell 0.6% and South Korea's Kospi fell 3.3%. This indicates a shift in risk appetite, not new operating evidence for AAPL, GOOGL, MSFT, Tencent or Pop Mart.

title.zh: 香港市场逆势小幅收高
title.en: Hong Kong edges higher against the broader pressure

detail.zh: RTHK 报道恒指由早段下跌转为收涨 111 点或 0.45% 至 24,917；指数反弹不能替代对 0700.HK 或 9992.HK 经营指标的验证。
detail.en: RTHK reported the Hang Seng reversed early losses to close up 111 points, or 0.45%, at 24,917; the rebound cannot substitute for operating-metric evidence at 0700.HK or 9992.HK.

title.zh: DRAM 现货仍呈分化，不能外推至行业周期
title.en: DRAM spot pricing remains mixed and cannot define the cycle

detail.zh: TrendForce 的 9 月 14 日现货页显示 DDR5 16Gb (2Gx8) 4800/5600 与 DDR4 8Gb (1Gx8) 3200 持平，而 DDR4 16Gb (2Gx8) 3200 下跌 0.56%。单日现货变化不等于合约价格、HBM 盈利或 DRAM 基金回报。
detail.en: TrendForce's September 14 spot page showed DDR5 16Gb (2Gx8) 4800/5600 and DDR4 8Gb (1Gx8) 3200 unchanged, while DDR4 16Gb (2Gx8) 3200 fell 0.56%. One-day spot moves are not equivalent to contract pricing, HBM profitability or DRAM ETF returns.
